records.name: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (NSF GRFP)
records.summary: The U.S. National Science Foundation's Graduate Research Fellowship Program supports outstanding graduate students pursuing research-based degrees in science and engineering. The program offers a five-year award with three years of financial support, including a stipend and a cost-of-education payment to the institution.
records.sourceTitle: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (NSF GRFP) | NSF - U.S. National Science Foundation
records.evidence: Support outstanding graduate students pursuing research-based degrees; the fellowship offers a five-year award with three years of financial support: $37,000 stipend plus $16,000 cost of education (COE) paid to the institution for each year of funding support.

records.name: Cooke Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship
records.summary: The Jack Kent Cooke Foundation's Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship is a selective award for top community college students seeking to complete a bachelor's degree at four-year colleges or universities in the United States. It can provide as much as $55,000 per year for two to three years and allows recipients to pursue any area of study.
records.sourceTitle: Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship - Jack Kent Cooke Foundation
records.evidence: The Cooke Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship is a highly selective scholarship for the nation's top community college students seeking to complete their bachelor's degrees at four-year colleges or universities.

records.name: Cooke College Scholarship Program
records.summary: The Cooke College Scholarship Program is an undergraduate scholarship for high-achieving high school seniors with financial need who seek to attend and graduate from four-year colleges and universities in the United States. The award is last-dollar funding and can provide as much as $55,000 per year toward a bachelor's degree in any area of study.
records.sourceTitle: College Scholarship Program - Jack Kent Cooke Foundation
records.evidence: The Cooke College Scholarship Program is an undergraduate scholarship program available to high-achieving high school seniors with financial need who seek to attend and graduate from the nation's top four-year colleges and universities.

records.name: Cooke Graduate Scholarship
records.summary: The Cooke Graduate Scholarship supports outstanding Cooke Scholars and recent alumni completing graduate degrees at accredited institutions. The official page states awards of up to $150,000 within four years, with a $75,000 annual cap, as last-dollar funding based on unmet financial need.
records.sourceTitle: Graduate Scholarship - Jack Kent Cooke Foundation
records.evidence: The Cooke Graduate Scholarship is awarded to outstanding Cooke Scholars and recent Alumni to support them to complete graduate degrees at top institutions.

records.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
records.providerName: Government of Canada (CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC)
records.summary: The Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships program was launched to attract and retain world-class doctoral students in Canada who demonstrate leadership and scholarly achievement. Up to 166 scholarships are awarded annually at $50,000 per year for three years across social sciences and humanities, natural sciences and/or engineering, and health.
records.sourceTitle: Nomination process: overview - Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
records.evidence: The Government of Canada launched the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships (Vanier CGS) program in 2008 to strengthen Canada's ability to attract and retain world-class doctoral students and establish Canada as a global centre of excellence in research and higher learning.

records.name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Master's (CGRS M)
records.providerName: Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (on behalf of CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC)
records.summary: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Master's supports graduate students in research-oriented master's programs at Canadian institutions. The program is jointly administered by Canada's three federal granting agencies and provides $27,000 for 12 months.
records.sourcePublisher: Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada
records.sourceTitle: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Master’s program | Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada
records.sourceNotes: Eligibility is stated as Canadian citizen, permanent resident of Canada or Protected Person under subsection 95(2) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act (Canada); ISO2 code CA is used for Canadian citizenship/permanent residence.
records.evidence: The CGRS M program supports up to 3,298 students annually in all disciplines and is administered jointly by Canada’s three granting agencies; value and duration: $27,000 for 12 months.

records.name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral (CGRS D)
records.providerName: Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (on behalf of CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC)
records.summary: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral supports and promotes research excellence in a wide variety of disciplines and broad fields of health, natural sciences and engineering, and social sciences and humanities. The award value is $40,000 per year for 36 months, and up to 15 percent of awards are available to international applicants.

records.name: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program (CPRA)
records.providerName: Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (on behalf of CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC)
records.summary: The Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program supports research excellence in health, natural sciences and engineering, and social sciences and humanities, and allows postdoctoral researchers to work in Canada or outside Canada. The award value is $70,000 per year for 24 months.

records.sourceTitle: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program | Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada

records.name: Undergraduate Student Research Awards (USRA)
records.providerName: Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (on behalf of CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC)
records.summary: Undergraduate Student Research Awards are meant to develop students' potential for research careers in health, natural sciences and engineering or social sciences and humanities and to encourage graduate study. The awards are valued at $6,000 plus a host institution contribution and are tenable only at eligible Canadian institutions.

records.sourceTitle: Undergraduate Student Research Awards | Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada

records.evidence: Undergraduate Student Research Awards (USRA) are meant to nurture your interest and fully develop your potential for a research career in health, natural sciences and engineering or social sciences and humanities.

records.name: Canadian Francophonie Scholarship Program
records.summary: The Canadian Francophonie Scholarship Program is designed to build institutional capacities by training nationals from developing countries of La Francophonie. Candidates may apply for university studies leading to a master's, doctoral and post-doctoral degree, for technical and vocational training, or for short-term training.
records.sourceTitle: Canadian Francophonie Scholarship Program
records.sourceNotes: The official page does not enumerate eligible nationalities or fields; it refers applicants to a separate CFSP website for funding levels and deadlines.
records.evidence: The Canadian Francophonie Scholarship Program (CFSP) is a scholarship program designed to build institutional capacities by training nationals from developing countries of La Francophonie.

records.name: Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships
records.providerName: Government of Canada (CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC)
records.summary: The Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships provide $70,000 per year for two years to postdoctoral researchers in health research, natural sciences and/or engineering, and social sciences and/or humanities. The official site says applications are no longer accepted and directs applicants to the Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program.
records.sourceTitle: Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships
records.sourceNotes: The official site states applications are no longer accepted and directs applicants to the Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program; degreeLevels is empty because this is a postdoctoral, non-degree fellowship.
records.evidence: Value & duration $70,000 per year (taxable), 2 years (non-renewable). Citizenship: Canadian citizens, Permanent residents of Canada, Foreign citizens.

records.name: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation PhD Scholarship
records.summary: The Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation PhD Scholarship supports doctoral students whose research in the humanities and social sciences, business, public health or law contributes to major issues facing Canada and the world. The UBC award listing states a value of up to $50,000 stipend plus up to $20,000 research and travel allowance per year for three years.
records.sourcePublisher: The University of British Columbia (Graduate School)
records.sourceTitle: Trudeau Foundation Doctoral Scholarship | Graduate School at The University of British Columbia (UBC)
records.sourceNotes: hostCountryCode is null because the source states Canadian students may study in Canada or abroad and international students must be enrolled at a Canadian university.
records.evidence: Value: Up to $50,000 stipend plus up to $20,000 research and travel allowance per year for three years. Citizenship: Canadian, Permanent Resident, International. Degree Level: Doctoral.

records.name: International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES)
records.summary: The International Major Entrance Scholarship is a merit-based entrance award for exceptional international students entering undergraduate programs at UBC. For the 2027/2028 academic year the awards are valued at $10,000 to $25,000 per year and are renewable for up to three additional years.

records.sourceNotes: The source requires international students to study at UBC on a Canadian study permit but does not list eligible nationalities.
records.evidence: International Major Entrance Scholarships (IMES) are awarded to exceptional international students entering undergraduate programs at UBC.

records.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
records.summary: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program enables graduate students, young professionals and artists from abroad to research and study in the United States for one year or longer at U.S. universities or other appropriate institutions. Application details and grant terms vary by country of citizenship and program.
records.sourceTitle: Apply for Fulbright and Explore Opportunities - Fulbright
records.evidence: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program enables graduate students, young professionals, and artists from abroad to research and study in the United States for one year or longer at U.S. universities or other appropriate institutions.

records.name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program
records.providerName: Institute of International Education (Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program)
records.summary: The Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship brings influential professionals from priority countries to the United States for graduate-level study and professional experiences at U.S. host universities and organizations. The program is funded by the U.S. Department of State and administered by the Institute of International Education.

records.name: Future Investigators in NASA Earth and Space Science and Technology (FINESST)
records.summary: FINESST solicits proposals for graduate student-designed and performed research projects relevant to NASA's Science Mission Directorate. Awards are research grants for up to three years at up to $50,000 per year.

records.evidence: FINESST solicits proposals for graduate student-designed and performed research projects relevant to NASA’s Science Mission Directorate. Awards are research grants for up to three years at up to $50K per year.

The research opportunity is expected to advance students' theses in areas central to the DOE Office of Science mission.

records.name: AAUW International Fellowships
records.summary: AAUW International Fellowships provide stipends to women pursuing full-time graduate study in the United States who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents. The official AAUW page states stipends of $20,000 for a master's degree and $25,000 for a doctorate degree.

records.name: Fulbright-Hays Doctoral Dissertation Research Abroad Program
records.summary: The U.S. Department of Education's Fulbright-Hays Doctoral Dissertation Research Abroad program provides grants to colleges and universities to fund individual doctoral students conducting dissertation research abroad. Students may propose research for 6 to 12 months, and the fellowship may not be renewed.

records.name: Schulich Leader Scholarships
records.summary: The Schulich Leader Scholarships are awarded to entrepreneurial-minded high school graduates enrolling in Science, Technology, Engineering or Math programs at 20 partner Canadian universities. The official site states 100 scholarships are awarded annually, half valued at $120,000 for engineering and half at $100,000 for science and math.
